anomalies.observed: REG3 pin 1 (OUT) is on +3.3V, but the separate +3V3 net has no regulator source and the FCC2/NAVC2 VDD pins are all in unconnected nets.
anomalies.expected: The 3V3 rail produced by LD39200PU33R should feed both MCUs and the sensor/IO pullups; MCU VDD pins must be connected to that 3.3 V net.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: Both MCUs are unpowered and the +3V3 pullups/VBAT/SWD supply are dead; the board cannot run.

anomalies.observed: The FCC 25 MHz crystal is wired to PE6/PE7 (FCC2 pins 5/37) rather than PH0/PH1, and the NAVC crystal is not connected to NAVC2 PH0/PH1.
anomalies.expected: HSE crystals must connect to the MCU oscillator pins PH0/PH1 (OSC_IN/OSC_OUT) for STM32H753 and STM32F405.
anomalies.impact: The MCUs will not use the intended external 25 MHz clock, causing clock failure or fallback to internal oscillators.

anomalies.observed: USB1 D+/D-/ID pass through series resistors into single-pin nets (NET0019, NET0124, NET0056); no CH330 UART-USB bridge component exists in the netlist.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires two otter_CH330 USB-to-UART bridges on the Connections sheet; USB data lines should terminate on those ICs.
anomalies.impact: At least one specified USB-UART bridge is absent, so the associated programming/debug port will not function.
